title: Novel fold and wing structure of Forkhead transcription factor facilitate DNA binding.
authors: Wang, George L; Jiang, Yibei; Sun, Yuying; Nasertorabi, Fariborz; Weller, Jesse A; Mitra, Raktim; Batyuk, Alexander; Aparicio, Oscar M; Cherezov, Vadim; Rohs, Remo
one_liner_zh: 该文解析酵母Fkh1转录因子DBD与DNA复合物晶体结构，结合MD模拟揭示翼区介导的DNA形状识别与结合机制，属于TF-DNA互作结构建模与动态机理研究，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Forkhead homologue 1 (Fkh1) is a yeast transcription factor that plays essential roles in cell-cycle dynamics. Here, we report the co-crystal structure of the DNA-binding domain (DBD) of the yeast Fkh1 protein in complex with a 19-base pair oligonucleotide containing the core binding site and flanking regions. The three-dimensional structure of the Fkh1-DBD reveals a previously unknown protein fold among all known Forkhead proteins. The winged-helix fold forms base-specific contacts of alpha-helix H3 with the major groove of the core binding site. Wing 1 and Wing 2 form DNA shape-mediated contacts with the minor groove of the binding site flanking regions. The conformation of Wing 2 is distinct from all known Forkhead proteins, with alpha-helices H5 and H6 wrapping back onto the protein core, creating a stable Wing 2 loop. Backbone interactions with beta-strands S1 and S2 reveal a structural mechanism for previously observed flanking region preferences in SELEX-seq experiments. In vivo yeast experiments on Fkh1 mutants demonstrate that wing residues interacting with flanking regions are important for Fkh1 function. Molecular dynamics simulations relate Fkh1 function to conformational flexibility of wing residues. The novel Forkhead fold enables Fkh1 function with implications, such as structure-based protein design, for other DNA-binding proteins.
abstract_zh: Forkhead同源物1（Fkh1）是一种酵母转录因子，在细胞周期动态中发挥重要作用。在此，我们报道了酵母Fkh1蛋白的DNA结合域（DBD）与包含核心结合位点及侧翼区域的19碱基对寡核苷酸复合物的共晶结构。Fkh1-DBD的三维结构揭示了一种在所有已知Forkhead蛋白中此前未知的蛋白质折叠。翼状螺旋折叠通过α-螺旋H3与核心结合位点的大沟形成碱基特异性接触。翼1和翼2通过DNA形状介导的接触与结合位点侧翼区域的小沟相互作用。翼2的构象与所有已知Forkhead蛋白不同，其中α-螺旋H5和H6回折至蛋白质核心，形成稳定的翼2环。与β-链S1和S2的主链相互作用揭示了先前在SELEX-seq实验中观察到的侧翼区域偏好的结构机制。对Fkh1突变体的体内酵母实验表明，与侧翼区域相互作用的翼残基对Fkh1功能至关重要。分子动力学模拟将Fkh1功能与翼残基的构象灵活性联系起来。新型Forkhead折叠使Fkh1功能得以实现，并对其他DNA结合蛋白具有启示意义，例如基于结构的蛋白质设计。
